{{Short description|Mathematical family}}
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Little ''q''-Jacobi polynomials}}In mathematics, the '''little ''q''-Jacobi polynomials'''  ''p''<sub>''n''</sub>(''x'';''a'',''b'';''q'') are a family of basic hypergeometric [[orthogonal polynomials]] in the basic [[Askey scheme]], introduced by {{harvtxt|Hahn|1949}}.<ref>{{Citation |last1=Hahn |first1=Wolfgang |title=Über Orthogonalpolynome, die q-Differenzengleichungen genügen |journal=[[Mathematische Nachrichten]] |volume=2 |issue=1–2 |pages=4–34 |year=1949 |doi=10.1002/mana.19490020103 |issn=0025-584X |mr=0030647}}</ref> {{harvs|txt | last1=Koekoek | first1=Roelof | last2=Lesky | first2=Peter A. | last3=Swarttouw | first3=René F. | title=Hypergeometric orthogonal polynomials and their q-analogues | publisher=[[Springer-Verlag]] | location=Berlin, New York | series=Springer Monographs in Mathematics | isbn=978-3-642-05013-8 | doi=10.1007/978-3-642-05014-5 | mr=2656096 | year=2010|loc=14}}<ref>{{dlmf||id=18|first=Tom H.|last=Koornwinder|first2=Roderick S. C.|last2=Wong|first3=Roelof|last3=Koekoek|first4=René F.|last4=Swarttouw}}</ref> give a detailed list of their properties.

==Definition==

The  little ''q''-Jacobi polynomials are given in terms of [[basic hypergeometric function]]s by 
:<math>\displaystyle  p_n(x;a,b;q) = {}_2\phi_1(q^{-n},abq^{n+1};aq;q,xq)  </math>
